designationHistory.name: Bamforth Lake Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Herbert Hoover established the Bamforth Lake Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 5783; it is now Bamforth National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bamforth National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 5783—Enlarging the Bamforth Lake Migratory Bird Refuge, Wyoming (Jan 29, 1932)

review.note: EO 5783, 1932-01-29 (Herbert Hoover). EO 5783 reserved public land as an addition to the Bamforth Lake Migratory Bird Refuge then being acquired under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act; its companion Hutton Lake order (EO 5782) is dated Jan. 28, 1932, one day earlier, matching the refuge page.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bamforth National Wildlife Refuge and Hutton Lake National Wildlife Refuge were established by executive orders in 1932 within one day of each other.
